children: US laboratory furniture maker's fiscal Q1 sales fell 6.7% yr/yr amid challenging market conditions
Diluted EPS declined to $0.58 from $1.04 in prior yr quarter
International segment profitability improved due to higher-margin projects despite lower sales
Company notes project award and release timelines remain extended amid geopolitical and economic uncertainty
Company says it remains attentive to near-term market conditions and focused on long-term growth
LIFE SCIENCES MARKET - Lower LPG sales and manufacturing volumes attributed to challenging life sciences market conditions
HIGHER-MARGIN PROJECTS - International segment profitability improved due to a favorable mix of higher-margin projects
ONE-TIME COMPENSATION EXPENSE - Corporate results included additional compensation expense from settling long-term incentive awards in cash, which is not expected to recur
